title: WoW Promised a Dance Studio in 2007. It Still Doesn't Exist.
hook: At BlizzCon in August 2007 Blizzard announced Wrath of the Lich King with the words "new dances" on screen, then spent years saying the Dance Studio was still coming. Nearly twenty years later it has never shipped. Which cancelled feature do you still want back?
script: Did you know World of Warcraft promised a Dance Studio in two thousand seven, and players are still waiting for it? Blizzard announced Wrath of the Lich King at BlizzCon in August of two thousand seven. The reveal trailer flashed the words new dances across the screen, and the official feature list promised new dance animations. A few weeks later, Blizzard explained the plan. Players would learn new and different dances at a place called the Dance Studio. Then the expansion shipped in late two thousand eight, and the studio was nowhere to be found. Blizzard said it would arrive after launch. In two thousand nine, a community manager said the artists were hacking away at it between raid patches. In two thousand ten, developers said it was still on the list. Years went by, and Blizzard never declared it dead, but never shipped it either. For April Fools in two thousand nine, Blizzard announced a fake dance battle system with crew versus crew challenges. Later April Fools patch notes claimed the Dance Studio had been removed from the game due to lack of use. Nearly twenty years after that first announcement, it has still never shipped. Which cancelled game feature do you still wish had happened? Follow for more gaming history.
